NEW BUG FOUND: KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake() at timer.tsx:77 and :105 is wrapped in a SYNC try/catch but on web it returns a Promise that rejects asynchronously — an uncaught 'The wake lock with tag ExpoKeepAwakeDefaultTag has not activated yet' error surfaced as a red screen after the recap closed. This is a real regression on web preview / could surface in Expo Go if the wake lock never activated. ui_bugs.issue: KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake() returns a Promise on web; the surrounding sync try/catch cannot catch its async rejection, producing an uncaught 'The wake lock with tag ExpoKeepAwakeDefaultTag has not activated yet' red-screen after Session Recap dismissal (and any other clearTimer path). Fix: KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake()?.catch?.(() => {}) at both timer.tsx:77 and timer.tsx:105.

react_native_issues.issue: Async promise rejection not handled — see ui_bugs. Reference: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:77 and :105.

action_items: In /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/timer.tsx, change both `try { KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake(); } catch {}` (lines 77 and 105) to `try { KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake()?.catch?.(() => {}); } catch {}` so the async wake-lock rejection is swallowed and no red screen appears after clearTimer / handleComplete.

Recap close path (setRecap(null)) correctly restores the timer screen without a black-screen residue.

rca_of_issue: Original user report ('Focus tab is not there anymore'): Root cause was almost certainly a top-level import of expo-screen-detector inside screenLock.ts which threw synchronously in environments where the native module was missing (Expo Go, web preview), breaking the entire timer.tsx bundle and thus removing the Focus route. Main-agent fix (lazy require inside getDetector() with try/catch and cached=null) is correct and verified. RESIDUAL bug found in the fix set: KeepAwake.deactivateKeepAwake() is a Promise on web — the current sync try/catch cannot suppress its async rejection, so any clearTimer call (recap close, stop, unmount) risks an uncaught-error red-screen on web / Expo Go. Reproduction: log in with uitest_token_123, tap Focus, tap Custom, enter 1, tap 'Start 1 min', wait 1 min, tap 'Nice! Back to my tree' on the recap — an 'Uncaught Error: The wake lock with tag ExpoKeepAwakeDefaultTag has not activated yet' red screen appears at app/(tabs)/timer.tsx:105:21. Mitigation: chain `.catch?.(() => {})` onto the deactivate call as described in action_items.
